// note: phase.json is the OUTERMOST lifecycle of the whole change. The guard reads it and refuses the next step if an artifact has not validated. Nothing here is reported by the agent: every hash is computed by the tool from the bytes on disk.
// note lifecycle_change_1.4: REMOVED 'spec' and 'tdd' from the lifecycle. Reason: the weak-model design already splits them down to a lower level. spec is NO LONGER a separate phase/document: it is embedded as behavior+acceptance in each task of plan.json. tdd is NO LONGER a separate phase: it is the FIRST STEP of each task's inner loop (write the test from the acceptance first, then the code). Both live at the TASK level, not the CHANGE level.

invariants.// note: craft.yml CANNOT turn these off. craft.yml only adjusts severity thresholds and switches optional detectors on or off.

// note where_spec_tdd_live.spec: dissolved into plan.json: each task carries a behavior (one sentence) and an acceptance (one test). SpecCoverageValidator reads straight from there; no proposal.md/design.md needed.
// note where_spec_tdd_live.tdd: dissolved into the inner loop of each task in the apply box: task = [write the test from the acceptance → apply code (weak model, improvement loop) → gate-code]. TDD is step 1 of that loop, at the task level.

authorized_exit_by.// note: the human approval is itself an artifact: the phase cannot exit until it exists

plan.// note: this phase REPLACES the old 'spec' phase. It produces plan.json, a flat task list where each task embeds a micro-spec (behavior+acceptance). This is the 'smart work done upstream': a strong model or a person splits the tasks here, once.

consumed.// note: GUARD: must equal the intent.produced hash. If intent.md changes after the plan ran, the hash differs and the plan is marked STALE. This is the provenance check.

produced.// note: plan.json holds all tasks, the micro-specs and the hash chain between tasks. There are NO separate proposal.md/design.md/tasks.md any more.

apply.// note: the apply box = RUN ALL of plan.json. Inside it, each task runs the inner loop [TDD → apply → gate]. tdd lives HERE, at the task level, not as a separate phase outside. Task details are in plan.json and are not copied up here.

consumed.// note: GUARD: must equal the plan.produced hash. Catches a plan.json that was edited by hand after sign-off.

produced.// note: the diff hash is the SUBJECT every downstream verdict must bind to. Computed as git diff | sha256, not declared by the agent.
produced.// note plan_progress: apply is complete only when EVERY task in plan.json has status complete (the guard reads plan.json to check; it does not trust the agent's word).

gate-code.// note: 1.3+ REQUIRED. The guard does not let finish run unless there is a gate-code entry whose verdict.bound_diff_sha256 == apply.produced.diff_sha256.

produced.// note: bound_diff_sha256 is the whole point. A PASS bound to an old diff does not authorize finishing a new diff: it closes both the skipped gate and the stale verdict.

verify.// note: runs the full test suite of the whole change and BLOCKS on failure. Unlike gate-code (which checks each diff), verify is the overall check before finish.

finish.// note: GUARD at finish: (1) gate-code.verdict resolves to PASS, (2) verdict.bound_diff_sha256 == the current git diff, (3) verify.status == complete. All three, or BLOCK.
